headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven expansion while others trimmed outlooks.
summary: Coforge led with 53.6% revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS showed solid AI revenue contributions and healthy margins. Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance and posted modest profit growth, signalling pressure. Wipro saw revenue rise but profit fell, highlighting margin stress.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, boosting top‑line and profit.

themes.title: Margin guidance and pressure
themes.detail: Infosys trimmed guidance; Wipro highlighted sequential margin uncertainty.

themes.title: Mid‑market acceleration
themes.detail: Coforge and LTM posted very high YoY revenue growth, driven by new mid‑size client wins.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to ~1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.

domain_outlook.note: Mphasis highlighted telecom‑driven AI cyber‑security spend.
